name: Green’s function
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用基本激励响应表示系统动力作用的函数。
usage_overview: 在板式轨道—路基动力分析中，以单位脉冲荷载引起的响应表征子系统的动力作用，用于计算荷载作用下该子系统的运动。

complete_examples.text: To achieve the high-efficient analysis of the VTS interaction with large DOFs, a Green’s function-based hybrid model is established.
In the hybrid model, the vehicle-rail interaction system is solved by the Park method, and the track slab-subgrade interaction system is solved by Green’s function method.
